title: Data classification baseline
summary: Operator-maintained classification scheme that labels data assets (public, internal, confidential, restricted, special-category) so downstream controls — DLP enforcement, egress filtering, regulator-notification routing — can act on classification rather than inferring sensitivity at runtime.

component.title: Data classification policy
component.description: Policy and labelling scheme classifying data assets by sensitivity tier.

control-implementations.description: Implements asset inventory and information-handling categorisation.

implemented-requirements.description: Security categorisation: assets are classified per the operator's labelling scheme.
Media marking: classification labels are applied to data at rest and in transit.

sources: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.12 — Classification of information
